name: NO_DITHER_PAT
note: dither order pattern 0 of SET_DITH_MATRIX (table base $3C9A, 16 bytes of $08: no dither); the old table $2A has NO_DITHER_PAT 16 bytes before BAYER_PAT, as here, but an all-$08 pattern is too plain to match by its bytes

name: CONTRAST_ROWS
note: SET_DITH_MATRIX (00:3447) takes row C (1-131, the CONTRAST value $C165) of this table, 6 bytes per row (three bases, three widths; docs §18.14): $3862-$3B73

name: BIT_COUNT
note: adds popcount(byte) + 2 x popcount(next byte) through the table at 04:4100 into BC, eight times per call from SCREEN_CHECK: the dark pixels of 2bpp rows (C); BIT_COUNT is the routine the source text left in the ROM describes for this (docs §18.14), so the name is I

name: MODE0
note: tile rows printed by PUT_MODE (00:163B): 5 entries of $18 bytes (two rows of 12 tiles), one per camera mode (C); the old table $2A names the same kind of table MODE0, next to EDGE0 / VREF0 / ZERO0 / REV0, which match by their bytes (its own bytes changed)

name: BitCount_Table
note: 256-byte popcount table (entry n = number of 1 bits of n), read by BIT_COUNT (00:3433, 00:343E) in the L2 runs

name: BitReverse_Table
note: 256-byte bit-reversal table ($01 -> $80, $02 -> $40 ...), read by ImageCopy_Mode01 in the L2 runs (a mirrored picture: I)

name: Zoom_TableA
note: 256-byte table (0 for n < $10, then 3, 12 ... by ranges), read by ImageCopy_Mode06 with BitDouble_Table in the L2 runs; role not decoded

name: BitDouble_Table
note: 256-byte table that doubles each bit of a nibble ($01 -> $03, $02 -> $0C ...: 4 pixels -> 8), read by ImageCopy_Mode06 in the L2 runs (a 2x zoom: I)

name: HalfBits_Table
note: 256-byte table keeping every other bit (00 00 01 01 00 00 01 01 02 02 03 03 ...), read by ImageCopy_Mode08 in the L2 runs (a reduction: I)

name: RESET
note: the boot code: Entry (00:0100), rst $00, rst $08 and the A+B+Select+Start reset (00:01C7) jump here; RESET at $0150 in both old symbol tables (the Japanese ROM calls its own Boot_ColdStart)

name: ImageCopy_Common2AC0

name: ImageCopy_Common2C4B
note: shared tail of the image-copy modes 17 and 18 (each sets DE and jumps here: jp $2C4B)

name: ImageCopy_ModeTable
